property: The stable SMTP mail-transfer and relay model is retained while an explicit capability-advertisement and extension-negotiation framework is added through EHLO and registered service extensions.

date_or_range.notes: Classic RFC 821 SMTP to first ESMTP service-extension framework generation.

sources.supports: extension advertisement/negotiation while retaining SMTP basis

negative_claims: This edge does not claim ESMTP replaces SMTP's core MAIL/RCPT/DATA transfer semantics wholesale.
It does not imply every SMTP extension existed in RFC 1425.
Individual extensions such as 8BITMIME, AUTH and STARTTLS require separate lineage records.
open_questions: Recover first operational EHLO deployments and compatibility incidents.
notes: Example of a mature protocol surviving through standardized extensibility rather than wholesale replacement.
